三个女鬼同样都是失足妇女，但不管她们是因为什么原因踏入这行的，都不是林浩宇可以残忍杀害她们的理由。

吴姜强忍着怒火，又带着三个女鬼回到了写字楼。

此刻，林浩宇的火气早已卸完，正在和未婚妻温柔的打着电话，女秘书正在帮他收拾东西，准备回家。

“宝贝，我刚忙完，你想吃什么？我去给你买！”

吴姜看着眼前的衣冠禽兽，缓缓收回缠在三个女鬼身上的勾魂索，淡淡的说了一句：

“别弄死了，其他的，随便你们玩！”

吴姜的话音刚落，指尖便凝出一缕漆黑的噬魂丝，指尖轻轻一弹，那噬魂丝如同有了灵性一般，精准缠上林浩宇脖颈间悬挂的金佛。

随着噬魂丝的越缠越多，原本通体鎏金、散发着温润金光的金佛，瞬间失去了光泽，周身笼罩的金光也随之消散。

金光一散，三个女鬼眼中瞬间迸射出刺骨的狠厉，嘴角勾起狰狞的笑意，如同挣脱枷锁的凶兽，朝着林浩宇猛扑而去。

林浩宇电话刚挂断，一抬头就看到凭空出现了三个披头散发，面色惨白、样貌狰狞的女鬼，瞳孔骤然收缩，吓得浑身一僵。

而他的女秘书，更是双眼一翻，更是连尖叫都没来得及发出，直接吓晕了过去。

“你......你们不是死了吗？”林浩宇的声音发颤，牙齿打颤的声响清晰可闻，脸上血色尽褪，满是难以置信。

显然，林浩宇已经认出了三个女鬼的身份。

这时，三个女鬼反倒不急了，桀桀怪笑着，缓步朝着林浩宇走去。

林浩宇脸色惨白如纸，豆大的冷汗顺着脸颊滑落，下意识地伸手去摸脖子上的金佛，但金佛如同死物一般，毫无反应。

“不……不可能！我的金佛怎么会没用？”林浩宇失声尖叫，声音里满是崩溃，这可是他爸花了大价钱请来的法器，怎么会没用？

The three female ghosts were also delinquent women, but no matter what reason they entered this industry, it was not the reason for Lin Haoyu to brutally kill them.

Wu Jiang suppressed his anger and returned to the office building with the three female ghosts.

At this moment, Lin Haoyu had already finished getting rid of his anger, and was on a gentle phone call with his fiancée. The female secretary was helping him pack his things and prepare to go home.

"Baby, I just finished my work. What do you want to eat? I'll buy it for you!"

Wu Jiang looked at the dressed beasts in front of him, slowly retracted the seductive ropes wrapped around the three female ghosts, and said lightly:

"Don't kill me. You can play with the rest as you like!"

As soon as Wu Jiang finished speaking, a jet-black soul-eating thread condensed from his fingertips. With a flick of his fingertips, the soul-eating thread seemed to have spirituality and accurately wrapped around the golden Buddha hanging around Lin Haoyu's neck.

As the soul-eating threads became more and more entangled, the golden Buddha, which was originally gilded and exuding warm golden light, instantly lost its luster, and the golden light surrounding it also dissipated.

As soon as the golden light dissipated, the eyes of the three female ghosts suddenly burst out with piercing fierceness, and the corners of their mouths raised ferocious smiles, like ferocious beasts that had broken free from their shackles, and pounced towards Lin Haoyu.

Lin Haoyu had just hung up the phone, and when he looked up, he saw three female ghosts with disheveled hair, pale faces, and ferocious looks appearing out of thin air. Their pupils suddenly shrank, and they froze in fear.

And his female secretary rolled her eyes and fainted without even having time to scream.

"You... aren't you dead?" Lin Haoyu's voice trembled, the sound of his teeth chattering could be clearly heard, the color on his face faded, and he was full of disbelief.

Obviously, Lin Haoyu has recognized the identities of the three female ghosts.

At this time, the three female ghosts were no longer in a hurry. Jie Jie smiled strangely and walked slowly towards Lin Haoyu.

Lin Haoyu's face was as pale as paper, and a heavy cold sweat slid down his face. He subconsciously reached out to touch the golden Buddha on his neck, but the golden Buddha was like a dead thing and showed no reaction.

"No...impossible! How could my Golden Buddha be useless?" Lin Haoyu screamed, his voice full of collapse. This is a magical weapon that his father spent a lot of money to buy. How could it be useless?
